bandwidth.basis: Computed at 0.1s resolution from the planned offsets and coordinated-phase greens, assuming vehicles travel at the design speed. Optimising one direction usually narrows the other; both are reported.

checks.label: Duplicate command
checks.detail: This timing plan has not been issued before.

checks.label: Command freshness
checks.detail: Plan age 0.00s is within the 5.0s window.

checks.label: Controller state readable
checks.detail: Controller 'Fixture cabinet' has a live protocol session.

checks.label: Timing plan channel
checks.detail: Protocol NTCIP_1202 has an implemented timing-plan channel.

checks.label: Cycle length within bounds
checks.detail: Cycle 40s is within [30, 180]s.

checks.label: Offset within cycle
checks.detail: Offset 0s lies within the 40s cycle.

checks.label: Splits match configured phases
checks.detail: Every configured phase has a split and no split names an unknown phase.

checks.label: Coordinated phase present
checks.detail: Coordinated phase 2 has a split.

checks.label: Splits allow minimum green and clearance
checks.detail: Every split covers minimum green, yellow change and all-red clearance.
checks.standard: MUTCD 4D.26 / NEMA TS 2 minimum green and clearance

checks.label: Split green within maximum green
checks.detail: No split's green exceeds the phase's configured maximum green.

checks.label: Pedestrian walk and clearance fit
checks.detail: Every split's green accommodates its configured walk and pedestrian clearance.

checks.label: Each ring sums to the cycle
checks.detail: Ring totals {1: 40, 2: 40} each equal the 40s cycle.

checks.label: Rings cross each barrier together
checks.detail: Both rings spend the same time in every barrier group, so neither crosses a barrier while the other is still green in the previous group.

checks.label: Concurrent phases are compatible
checks.detail: Phase pair(s) [(2, 6)] share a barrier in opposite rings, so this plan would run them together, but they are configured as conflicting.
checks.standard: NEMA TS 2 dual-ring barrier conflict matrix
